# vector

> Intelligent subagent model router for any harness. Routes coding-agent
> subagents to cheap models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Kimi-K3) while
> keeping frontier planning on Claude and Codex subscriptions.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): agent setup and operation (start here)
- [docs/configuration.md](./docs/configuration.md): full configuration guide
- [docs/install.md](./docs/install.md): install, service, Docker, CI
- [docs/architecture-proposal.md](./docs/architecture-proposal.md): design

## Self-describing

```sh
vector guide --json    # guide + live state
vector schema          # config JSON Schema
vector setup --json    # non-interactive one-shot setup
```

## Install

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anunay999/vector/main/install.sh | sh
```
